REVIEW-01.behaviour: Malformed or unknown review token is rejected before any storage call

REVIEW-02.behaviour: Expired review token returns 410 and writes nothing

REVIEW-03.behaviour: Valid token returns only the public round view (no internal fields)

REVIEW-04.behaviour: Client submission writes clientPick and comments to design.json through storage

REVIEW-05.behaviour: Submissions are rejected once the round is locked; clients cannot approve or lock

REVIEW-06.behaviour: Stale write (SHA conflict) returns 409 and overwrites nothing

REVIEW-07.behaviour: Review page flow: load round, pick, comment, submit

AUTH-01.behaviour: /api/admin requires a Cloudflare Access JWT with valid signature, audience and expiry

AUTH-02.behaviour: Access user not in ALLOWED_EMAILS gets 403

SUPPORT-01.behaviour: Public support intake validates input with zod and Turnstile before writing

SUPPORT-02.behaviour: Triage assigns category and priority from the request text

INTAKE-01.behaviour: Intake submission is validated and stored as a new inbox item

STORAGE-01.behaviour: Local and GitHub storage behave the same for every interface method

UI-01.behaviour: Pipeline board shows each client in its stage column

forbidden.name: shared-is-pure

forbidden.name: no-ui-in-backend

forbidden.name: storage-through-interface

restrictedStrings.message: Only the GitHub storage implementation talks to GitHub. Go through StorageInterface.

CUJ-PIPELINE.title: Josh signs in through Cloudflare Access and sees every client in its pipeline stage
steps: See each client card in its stage column
Open a client and see its detail

CUJ-REVIEW.title: A client opens the review link, picks a design option, comments and submits their choice
steps: See the round's options (and nothing internal)
Pick an option and add a comment
Josh sees the pick on the client's round

CUJ-SUPPORT.title: A client submits a support request and it arrives triaged in Josh's support inbox
steps: Fill in the request and pass Turnstile
Josh opens the support inbox and sees it with a category and priority

CUJ-INTAKE.title: A new client's intake submission shows up as a new item in Josh's inbox
steps: Josh opens the inbox and sees the new item
Open the item and read the details
